requirements.statement: Visible content that carries information remains present when style sheets are disabled.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, l’information reste-t-elle présente lorsque les feuilles de styles sont désactivées ?
Vérifier si dans le document dépourvu de styles, les contenus visibles porteurs d'information restent présents ;

routes.statement: The information is in the document itself, so it is still there once styles are disabled.

citations.quote: « Contenu présent » signifie que le contenu visible reste présent lorsque CSS est désactivé.

routes.statement: An information-carrying image given as a CSS background is accompanied by hidden text that carries the information.

citations.quote: En revanche, une image porteuse d’information en propriété de fond CSS mais accompagnée d’un texte caché valide ce test car l’information est bien « présente » lorsque CSS est désactivé.

rationale.text: The test asks that visible content carrying information stay present once style sheets are disabled. The glossary gives two ways: the content is in the document, or an information-carrying image set as a CSS background is accompanied by hidden text. Both turn on judgment. Whether a CSS background image, a pseudo-element's generated text or an icon drawn by CSS carries information or is decoration cannot be decided by code, and neither can whether hidden text beside it conveys the same information. A mechanical difference between the styled and unstyled page, such as generated content that disappears, proves nothing on its own, because the lost content may be decorative. So no check can fault under every reading or decide the requirement, and the entry is none. No axe rule is tagged. Applicability is judgment: the criterion concerns visible content that carries information, and whether a page holds any is judgment. Needs is empty: disabling style sheets can be done on the page as loaded; none of the listed prerequisites describes it.
